bibl.author: Gilbert the Universal [†1134], bishop of London
bibl.title: (attrib.), Gloss on the Old Testament. Gilbert wrote the Glossa ordinaria on Lamentations, and very probably that on the Pentateuch and the major prophets; Robert of Bridlington also attributed to him the gloss on the minor prophets. The extant manuscript contains the glosses from Genesis to Kings.
